source: located_without_universe_ids in data/generated/build_report.json on main after pull request 32
why: These 36 deal ids are the located Pipeline and Land rows that still have no counted Universe row. The check fails when a located deal id is missing from this list. Clearing an id that is already listed stays green, so the open backlog does not keep every pull request red. A count ceiling would stay green after this backlog shrinks and a different located deal appears at or under that ceiling, including a one-for-one swap. The build does not rewrite this file. It does not mint a Universe row, invent a coordinate, or invent a parcel number, and it does not write the workbook.
